project.organized.title: Organized
project.organized.text: This project reproduces a factory production line. It uses the concept of « linked lists » to simulate the operation of an assembly line with different production stages.
project.wolf3d.title: Wolf3D
project.wolf3d.text: This project is a clone of the famous Wolfenstein 3D game. It was developed in C and uses the CSFML library for graphics interactions. The 3D rendering was achieved through a rendering engine we recreated using the technology of the Raycasting.
project.arcade.title: Arcade
project.arcade.text: This project is a modular C++ arcade game engine that lets you play several games with different graphics libraries (ncurses, SDL2, raylib), switching between them mid-game without interrupting gameplay.
project.raytracer.title: Raytracer
project.raytracer.text: This project is a CPU-based ray tracing engine that generates photorealistic images from text-defined 3D scenes. It simulates light propagation by casting a ray per pixel and computing intersections with scene objects.
project.raytracer.li2: Ambient, directional lighting and ambient occlusion
project.raytracer.li4: Scenes editable through text configuration files
project.zappy.title: Zappy
project.zappy.text: Zappy is a real-time multiplayer game where several teams compete on a toroidal map searching for rare resources, aiming to bring at least 6 players to the maximum level.
project.echoingvoid.title: Echoing Void
project.echoingvoid.text: This project is a Minecraft Java mod (Fabric) porting content from the Minecraft Dungeons « Echoing Void » DLC. It expands the End dimension with a new biome, custom mobs, an endgame progression system, and legendary items, without altering base gameplay.
project.echoingvoid.li1: New « Void Islands » biome with parkour challenges
